name: glacier-tasks-workspace
description: Glacier Tasks — offline Jira-inspired desktop task planner (Electron + Angular)

scripts.start: npm run build -w @glacier-tasks/domain -w @glacier-tasks/data && concurrently -k -n pkgs,ui,app -c gray,blue,cyan "tsc -b -w --preserveWatchOutput packages/domain packages/data" "npm start -w @glacier-tasks/ui" "wait-on tcp:localhost:4200 && npm run dev -w @glacier-tasks/desktop"
scripts.package:dir: npm run build && npm run package:dir --workspace @glacier-tasks/desktop
